dependency: Canonical FOOD-006X converged result plus exactly one later acquireFoodAuthoritativeInventoryEvidenceHead (FOOD-006N1) call.
latestStateStatement: The converged snapshot remains the latest recorded-evidence state for the exact SKU as of that later head check.
eligibility: Only canonical converged. Canonical invalid, ineligible, no-correction-required and not-converged return ineligible with upstreamOutcome without reads.

outcomes.ineligible: Canonical non-success X branch; zero reads.
outcomes.storage-failure: Later head regressed, exact SKU disagrees, or canonical N1 fails. N1 invalid after canonical X is internal selector disagreement.
outcomes.validated: Later exact-SKU head equals convergence cutoff.
outcomes.stale: Later exact-SKU head exceeds cutoff; later recorded evidence exists, not a claim that the historical balance is wrong.

safeStatement: validated means no later exact-SKU inventory evidence sequence was observed between the converged FOOD-006X cutoff and the later authoritative head check.
concurrency: Unrelated exact-SKU evidence can advance the head. No correction causality or correction-caused head movement is required. Evidence may arrive immediately after the primary head query.
doesNotEstablish: absence of unrelated evidence before cutoff
no evidence after the later check
invariants: Negative recorded balances remain discrepancy/evidence state, never clamped or interpreted as negative physical stock. Physical counts stay nonnegative. Preserve all existing product/recipe/package/SKU/price/availability/order/payment/customer identity distinctions.
title: Continued recorded-evidence freshness validation
latestStateMeaning: Only latest state represented by the authoritative exact-SKU inventory evidence sequence at that bounded check under immutable evidence/durable-record assumptions; not physical-world stock truth.
databaseReads: Exactly one FOOD-006N1 acquisition for eligible converged input (one aggregate read on success); zero for invalid/ineligible. Storage failure can precede query execution.
runtimeBoundary: No direct SQL/session, recomposition, new count/reconciliation, writer, transaction, timestamp, ID, or persistence. X invokes existing pure provenance validators internally. Real D1 primary/bookmark/trigger/concurrency validation and deployment remain separate; production sequencing is not asserted.
canonicalization: Detach plain enumerable acyclic data without invoking getters/hooks; reject symbols/hidden fields. Reclassify retained correctionInclusionVerification through FOOD-006X and compare canonical JSON deep values. Canonicalize no-correction via X. Validate exact simple negative envelopes. Recursively freeze detached canonical provenance before await.
provenance: Validated/stale retain sku, convergenceCutoff, laterExactSkuEvidenceHead, detached frozen convergence and complete canonical acquired envelope as laterHeadAcquisition. Storage-failure is a narrow outcome without partial certification.
bookmark: Opaque bookmark retained inside laterHeadAcquisition only; no duplicate field, equality comparison, or snapshot claim. N1 bookmark failure remains storage-failure even for advanced heads.
